title: D2 Loop Register Update
statement: For any language $P$, input word $x$, and bound $B$, suppose $i,u\le B$. For every $b,p\in\mathbb{N}$ with $p+b\le B$, the search program, using its oracle determined by $P$, can reach the configuration at location $\mathrm{dbl}$ with registers $(i,p+b,0,u)$ from location $\mathrm{d2}$ with registers $(i,p,b,u)$, without leaving the configurations satisfying the program precondition and the bound $B$ on every register at any earlier step.
hypotheses_covered: The input is $x$ and the oracle is determined by $P$
